visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Wrong When the First Is Largest
visualizerParams.problemDescription: For the numbers 50, 20 and 10 the program prints 20, but the largest is 50.

solution.explanation: The first branch was changed so that it returns b even when a is the winner, and the || makes the test true too often. Each branch must return the same variable it has proven to be largest.
